title: Jump-1
description: A 2d6 space-trading roguelite. Crew a 200-ton ship bought on credit, trade across the Lantern Reach, and stay ahead of the bank's repossession cruiser. English by default, with French available.
controls: Mouse or touch: choose actions, worlds and cargo.
Arrow keys: move map cursor. Enter or Space: confirm. Escape: back.
1-5: crew stations. L: log. M: map. S: ship. R: standard week. Q: quick stop.
Solo campaign. The cooperative edition is not available.
credits: Cédric Bernadac - design, original setting, publication.
Developed with Codex and Kimi K3.1. Original Blender art by Kimi under the direction of Cédric Bernadac.
First-voyage guide and draggable map by Claude Opus 5.5. Visual refresh 0.2.0 by Nilo / Codex with Kimi K3.1. Navigation briefings, scene guidance and action reports in 0.3.0 by Nilo / Codex.
Original music and sound effects generated with Suno; permitted source exports preserved. See ASSETS-LICENSE.md and assets/audio/AUDIO-PROVENANCE.json.
Rules derived from the Cepheus Engine System Reference Document, Open Game License 1.0a; see OGL.md. Jump-1 is compatible with the rules of Cepheus Engine.
LOB7 Rooms SDK bundled unchanged as lob7-rooms.js.
Voyage rules 0.4.0 by Nilo / Codex: contextual events, crew assistance, compact inspections, branching routes, ship fittings, trade requests and persistent stories.
